name: movement disorders overview
title: Tremor or slowness: a symmetric postural or action tremor that improves with alcohol is essential tremor; asymmetric rest tremor with rigidity, bradykinesia and postural instability is parkinsonism, which is Parkinson's disease only once drugs, basal ganglia lesions, head trauma, toxins, PSP and MSA are excluded; each with its treatment

root.title: Tremor or slowness: WHEN is the tremor worst, and is it on ONE side?
lines: • hyperkinetic (too much movement): ballismus · chorea · athetosis · tremor · dystonia · tics
• hypokinetic (too little): parkinsonism, with bradykinesia (slow) and akinesia (hard to start)

groups.title: PARKINSONISM: a syndrome
lines: tremor · rigidity · bradykinesia · postural instability, in any mix

head: h
Essential tremor
may be hereditary · worsens over time
pres: • arms most, also head and voice

head: h
Parkinson's disease
dopamine neurons of the substantia nigra die · onset about 60
pres: • Rigidity: same at any speed, ↑ with augmentation
• small handwriting · masked face · soft voice · less arm swing · stooped, turns en bloc
tx: Not functionally limiting → no treatment yet
• most effective: bradykinesia, rigidity best · tremor variable
• watch: on-off, wearing off · dyskinesia (50% by 5 years)

head: h
Parkinsonism from ANOTHER cause
Parkinson's disease is only ONE cause
pres: • basal ganglia stroke, bleed, tumour, infection
• repeated head trauma · carbon monoxide, cyanide
• VERTICAL gaze palsy, overcome by vestibular reflexes
tx: Do NOT call it Parkinson's disease
• other neurodegenerative causes: MSA, PSP, diffuse Lewy body disease
• MSA: death within 6-9 years of onset
